title: Local authorization JWKS v1
description: Public keys served at GET /.well-known/jwks.json. Only EC P-256 public keys for ES256. Closed schema: private members ('d', 'p', 'q', ...) are rejected. Fetching this document does NOT establish trust in the host: the instance key must be bootstrapped through an operator-provisioned or independently confirmed fingerprint (SPEC §27.1); rotation requires a validated chain of trust or new explicit consent.

Base64UrlCoordinate.description: P-256 coordinate, 32 bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters).
